cases.input: Render a canonical learning model into a portable responsive HTML learning page with takeaways, mental model, source map and timestamp deep links.
requiredBehaviors: render only content already present in the canonical model
produce semantic responsive accessible portable HTML
validate timestamps anchors visuals overflow print view and design compliance
forbiddenBehaviors: turn the page into a generic decorative SaaS landing page

cases.input: The canonical model has no SOP and only three sections, while several optional visuals are unavailable.
requiredBehaviors: render only modules that actually exist
preserve navigation and source traceability for the available content
forbiddenBehaviors: fill missing visuals with decorative unsupported content

cases.input: The page changes a claim, embeds inaccessible navigation requiring JavaScript, clips SVG labels on mobile and reports PASS without checking timestamp links.
requiredBehaviors: reject QA PASS with clipping or unchecked timestamp links
